source.statement: Tentative gear ratio for the 2027-2028 car is 12.48. Motor speed/top speed and gear efficiency are not yet known.

limitations: 12.48:1 is a provisional user-reported value, not a verified hardware specification.
The simulator interprets gear_ratio as motor angular speed divided by driven-wheel angular speed. The team must confirm that 12.48 is the total reduction across all stages.
Unknown efficiency, motor speed, top speed and topology must not be filled from synthetic defaults as team facts.
Historical runs and searched controllers retain their original 4:1 synthetic gearing and are not established as optimal for this provisional ratio.
